title: SchemaGraph contract v1
description: Machine-readable form of the canonical schema contract (docs/architecture/schema-graph-contract.md, Part A and Part B). This file carries structural rules only: types, enumerations, required fields, length caps and numeric bounds. The semantic rules (unique ids, declared-target resolution, duplicate pairs, composite-group consistency, inferred dedupe) live in normalize() in skill/scripts/build_explorer.py, which stays the single oracle and is never reimplemented. Unknown fields are ignored rather than rejected, so a minor version may add fields without breaking an older reader. Caveat references are ids only; the wording lives in docs/reference/caveats.md.

scalar.title: Bounded JSON scalar
scalar.description: A single retained value. Strings are capped at MAX_SCALAR_LENGTH (256) characters, the same bound the profiler applies before a value leaves the database. See C05.

legacyBoolean.title: Boolean flag with the legacy string and integer forms
legacyBoolean.description: A boolean flag as emitted by adapters over the life of the contract: a JSON boolean, the legacy strings accepted by boolean() in build_explorer.py, the integers 0 and 1, or null for unknown. normalize() coerces every form to a JSON boolean before a view sees it.

identifier.title: Physical or display identifier
identifier.description: An identifier keeps every character it carries; only the length cap applies (NAME_CAP, 256). No character-set pattern is imposed under v1, so a table id may contain dots and other separators.

displayText.title: Short display string
displayText.description: A single-line display value, capped at NAME_CAP (256) characters. normalize() strips control characters and bidi overrides and rejects an over-length value rather than truncating it.

longText.title: Long display string
longText.description: A multi-line display value, capped at TEXT_CAP (4096) characters. Shown escaped and never executed.

SchemaProject.title: Project identity
SchemaProject.description: Identity of the schema under review. The key scopes browser storage and review decisions and must stay stable for one project environment. See C13.

name.description: Human-readable project name. Rendered escaped in the header, the provenance footer and the artifact title.

key.description: Stable lowercase key, matching the character set normalize() enforces. Two environments with identical table names must not share a key.

dialect.description: SQL dialect of the source. Defaults to unknown, which turns generated SQL off. Generated SQL is supported for postgresql and sqlite only, and is always a draft the product never executes. See C04.

SchemaSource.title: Evidence provenance
SchemaSource.description: Where the graph came from and how far its evidence reaches. normalize() supplies a default for every field so the provenance footer is never blank; adapters should still emit the real values. See C09.

file.description: Path or identifier of the evidence source.

commit.description: Verified reference or snapshot id. The provenance footer shows its first eight characters.

sha256.description: Hash of the source bytes, or a recorded placeholder.

basis.description: What the evidence covers and what it does not. Shown as the provenance tooltip. See C09.

ColumnProfiling.title: Column statistics from a bounded sample
ColumnProfiling.description: Per-column observations from an explicitly requested, read-only, capped sample. Absent fields are unknown, never zero. See C01 and C05.

nullFraction.description: Observed fraction of NULL values in the sample, or null when the sample was empty.

distinctCount.description: Distinct non-NULL values observed in the sample. A sample distinct count is not a database uniqueness guarantee. See C05.

min.description: Smallest value observed in the sample, as a bounded scalar. Extremes can be sensitive and are never published implicitly.

max.description: Largest value observed in the sample, as a bounded scalar.

sampled.description: True when the statistics come from a sample rather than the whole table. See C05.

scope.description: Scope label for the statistics, for example sampled or table.

sampleValues.description: At most three distinct, non-NULL, bounded scalars, retained only when the caller opted in. Exports strip them unless the exporter opts in as well.

SchemaColumn.title: Column
SchemaColumn.description: One column of a table. Only name is required on the wire; normalize() supplies the defaults the views rely on, so the generated TypeScript type describes the normalized document.

name.description: Physical column name, unique within its table.

type.description: Declared type as written in the evidence source. An unknown type stays Unknown rather than being guessed.

pk.description: Primary-key membership flag. An explicit primaryKey array on the table takes precedence. A column named id is not a primary key without evidence.

fk.description: Display-only foreign-key target text. Actual relationships come from links; a link is never invented from this text. See C07.

nullable.description: Tri-state nullability: an empty string means unknown, otherwise True or False. Booleans and the legacy string forms are accepted on the wire and coerced by normalize().

index.description: Whether the column carries a single-column index. Partial and expression indexes are excluded from coverage heuristics.

unique.description: Whether the column carries a unique constraint of its own. Membership in a composite unique group is a different fact and is not this flag. See C06.

file.description: Evidence file for this column, when it differs from the graph source.

line.description: Line in the evidence file. A non-negative integer; a string is rejected.

typeBasis.description: How the type was established, for example a catalog read or an ORM model.

typeDefinition.description: Full type definition text, for example an enumeration body.

default.description: Default as recorded by the adapter, without a claim about where it is applied.

serverDefault.description: Default the database applies. See C15.

applicationDefault.description: Default the application applies. It is not a SQL default and does not constrain rows written by other clients. See C15.

ondelete.description: Referential action recorded for this column's declared relationship.

profiling.description: Bounded sample statistics for this column.

sampleValues.description: At most three distinct, non-NULL, bounded scalars, written at the column level by the profiler when the caller opted in.

SchemaIndex.title: Index or unique group
SchemaIndex.description: An ordered column group. Column-level unique constraints appear as single-column groups; ordered composite groups stay intact.

columns.description: Ordered column names. Every name must exist in allColumns unless the group is an expression index.

partial.description: Whether the index is partial or filtered. Partial indexes are removed from generic full-coverage heuristics.

expression.description: Whether the index is over expressions rather than plain columns. Expression indexes are removed from generic full-coverage heuristics.

SchemaCheck.title: Check constraint
SchemaCheck.description: A named check constraint. The definition is display-only and is never executed. See C04.

definition.description: Constraint body as written in the evidence source.

TableProfiling.title: Table-level profiling metadata
TableProfiling.description: Metadata about the profiling run for one table, including its completeness. An incomplete table keeps whatever statistics were gathered; everything else stays unknown. See C01 and C05.

status.description: Whether the profiling run finished for this table. An incomplete table is labelled, never back-filled with zeros. See C01 and C05.

reason.description: Why the run is incomplete, in fixed wording chosen by the worker.

sampled.description: True when the metadata comes from a sample rather than the whole table.

SchemaTable.title: Table or view
SchemaTable.description: One entity of the graph. Additional catalog metadata is kept as data and passed through unchanged.

rowCountLowerBound.description: A lower bound is meaningful only while the exact count is unknown, so rowCount must be null or absent beside it. See C01.

id.description: Unique lookup id for the table. It may contain dots; identifiers are never split on dots for SQL generation.

name.description: Physical table name, supplied separately from the display id.

className.description: Application or ORM class name for this entity.

domain.description: Declared domain, or a discovered community label. A discovered community is an analytical suggestion. See C03.

type.description: Entity category. The visual uses Core master entity, Transaction / operational, Association / detail, Configuration / reference and Audit / integration state; custom labels are allowed and Unclassified is used when evidence is insufficient.

kind.description: Whether the entity is a base table or a view. Defaults to table. View metadata never supplies executable SQL. See C04.

definition.description: View or entity definition text. Display-only and never executed. See C04.

file.description: Evidence file for this table, when it differs from the graph source.

line.description: Line in the evidence file. A non-negative integer; a string is rejected.

pk.description: Primary-key column names joined for display. normalize() derives it from primaryKey or from the primary-key flags.

primaryKey.description: Ordered primary-key column names. When present it takes precedence over the per-column flags and preserves a composite key's declared order.

allColumns.description: Every column of the entity, with unique non-empty names.

uniques.description: Unique groups, including single-column constraints. See C06.

rowCount.description: Exact row count from the adapter or from an exhausted sample, or null when unknown. Zero is a measured value and is never substituted for unknown. See C01.

rowCountLowerBound.description: Lower bound from a capped sample. A capped sample yields a lower bound, not a total, and it is present only while rowCount is unknown. See C01.

rowCountExact.description: Whether rowCount is exact rather than a floor.

sampleSize.description: Rows examined for this table by the last profiling run.

sampled.description: True when the last profiling run sampled this table.

SchemaLink.title: Relationship
SchemaLink.description: One ordered column pair. A composite foreign key is emitted as one link per pair, all sharing a non-empty constraintId, and counts once as a relationship while the association count is column pairs. See C11.

source.description: Child table id. It must exist in tables.

column.description: Child column name. It must exist in the source table.

target.description: Parent table id. A declared target must resolve in the loaded scope; an inferred target may be absent and is then labelled unresolved.

kind.description: Evidence class, exactly one of the two values. A declared relationship comes from whatever evidence source the snapshot identifies; a naming-based one is an observation about column names. The two classes stay distinguishable in data, styling and labels. See C07 and C09.

constraintId.description: Constraint identity, non-empty and unique within the source table. Every pair of one composite foreign key shares it. See C11.

ondelete.description: Referential action recorded for the relationship.

cardinality.description: Cardinality when the evidence establishes it, otherwise unknown.

SchemaGraph.title: SchemaGraph
SchemaGraph.description: The exchange format adapters emit and the artifact renders. It is an exchange format, not a claim that every database uses the same type system.

contractVersion.description: Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. A document without the field is treated as 1.0. A different major version is rejected; a higher minor version is accepted and its unknown fields are ignored.

tables.description: Every table and view in the selected scope, with unique ids.

links.description: Every relationship, one entry per ordered column pair.
